content.title: Skyworks Solutions names AMD executive Philip Carter as CFO
content.summary: He is leaving Advanced Micro Devices, where he has served as corporate vice president and chief accounting officer since November 2024.  Carter notified AMD on Friday that he will resign, the company said, adding that his departure is not due to any disagreement over accounting practices or financial reporting.  He previously worked at Skyworks between 2017 and 2024, including as vice president and corporate controller.

content.title: SWKS Q2 Deep Dive: Mobile Upside and Broad Markets Momentum Shape Outlook
content.summary: Wireless chips maker Skyworks Solutions (NASDAQ: SWKS) reported Q2 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6.6% year on year to $965 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($1.02 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 13.9% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.33 per share was 7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
